Great to connect earlier \u0014 thanks for the time. As promised, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the security review milestone and SOC 2 package delivery items we discussed. High-level recap and next steps below:

- Target close: end of Q4 if evidence delivered and legal review completes on schedule.
- Internal reviewers: Security (Aurelia) will validate evidence, Procurement will sign PO.

MAP milestone (security review / SOC 2 package):
- Deliverables (Redwood): completed SOC 2 questionnaire (PDF), evidence checklist (Excel), and sample ACL/access logs (redacted).
- Responsibilities: Redwood (Marissa + Eng ops) to compile and deliver; Aurelia (Liam/Sophia) to review and confirm acceptance or request clarifications.
- Target due date (for initial package): 2026-10-16.
- Dependencies: successful redaction of PII in sample logs and confirmation of secure transfer method (SFTP/Drive with signed NDA).

I've attached: Redwood_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.0.pdf, Evidence_List_Aurelia.xlsx, MAP_Draft_AureliaTech_20261012.xlsx.

Ask / next steps:
1) Liam/Sophia: confirm that 10/16 works for initial delivery and whether you prefer SFTP or shared Drive (with access list).
2) If Procurement needs a different artifact (formal SOC 2 attestation copy), flag now \u0014 we can route legal.
3) We'll plan a 30-min review call for 10/17 to walk through any gaps. Please suggest times.

Thanks \u0014 I'll coordinate with Aditya on the artifacts.
